task_completion.description: The agent opens the DICOM viewing software and loads the CT scan image.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A medical imaging interface (DICOM viewer) is visible on the screen showing a 256x256 CT scan image.

task_completion.description: The agent positions the cursor or probe tool at (128, 128) to read the value.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The cursor or a crosshair tool is positioned near the center of the image, and a value (approx 2000 or 976) is visible in the UI overlay.

task_completion.description: The agent positions the cursor or probe tool at (64, 64) to read the value.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The cursor or a crosshair tool is positioned in the top-left quadrant of the image, and a value (approx 1000 or -24) is visible in the UI overlay.

task_completion.description: The agent positions the cursor or probe tool at (192, 192) to read the value.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The cursor or a crosshair tool is positioned in the bottom-right quadrant of the image, and a value (approx 3000 or 1976) is visible in the UI overlay.

task_completion.description: The agent creates the results file at the specified path with the correct header.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal shows the creation of '~/DICOM/exports/pixel_probe_results.txt' with the header 'Pixel Probe Results'.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the three recorded values into the text file using the required format.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The final text file is shown containing the three coordinates and their corresponding numeric values (VALUE1, VALUE2, VALUE3).

integrity.description: The agent must use the GUI probe tool rather than just calculating values via script.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor moving to the specific coordinates within the DICOM viewer UI.

integrity.description: The agent should not simply echo the values into a file without first viewing them in the software.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent must have the DICOM viewer open and active before the text file is finalized.

integrity.description: The agent saves the file to the specific requested directory, not a default location.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file path '~/DICOM/exports/pixel_probe_results.txt' is visible during the save process or in a file explorer.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The ground truth values for the coordinates are: (128,128) is 2000 (raw) or 976 (HU); (64,64) is 1000 (raw) or -24 (HU); (192,192) is 3000 (raw) or 1976 (HU). The agent may record either the raw or HU value as long as it matches the software display. A tolerance of ±5 pixels for coordinates and ±100 for values is acceptable.
